newsitem.title: USA: Seagull has stake in Norcen natgas find.
newsitem.headline: Seagull has stake in Norcen natgas find.

text.p: Seagull Energy Corp said it participated in a new fault block natural gas discovery drilled at Eugene Island Block 107 off the coast of Louisiana in the Gulf of Mexico by Norcen Explorer Inc.
Seagull said it the 17,350-foot No. 3 well, which is presently being completed, encountered 125 to 165 feet of productive natural gas sands in seven zones.

The productive sands are in a separate fault block from existing production in the Eugene Island 107/118 complex that presently delivers about 17 million cubic feet of natural gas and 285 barrels of oil per day.
Seagull said the production from the No. 3 well will begin flowing to markets early in the second quarter.

Norcen Explorer, a subsidiary of Norcen Energy Resources Ltd, has a 49 percent interest and is operator of the discovery well. Seagull and Enserch Exploration Inc hold 24.5 percent each and Case-Pomeroy Oil Corp holds the remaining two percent. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
